fields.li: Lighting (observed from both references): flat colour, no directional light, no shading ramps. Design language (proposed, owner may override): no anti-aliasing, binary alpha and the blocky low-detail construction of the references carried into a genuinely side-view figure; the references' front-facing symmetric shape is a style swatch, not the character design. Outline (adopted for the sample from the controlled-evaluation answers, not an owner confirmation): outlined as reference.png, a flat #25354A contour of the references' weight (2 px measured) fully enclosing the body, with the same navy forming the shoulder bar, the base bar and the solid top stalks. Identity landmarks that the sample readability criterion names and that must stay separable in profile: the solid navy top-stalk silhouette (the references' two stalks adapted to side view), at least one cream eye, the navy shoulder bar and the navy base bar. Pose (scoped specialist choice for the sample): one idle pose facing right; the engine can mirror it.
